#include<stdio.h>
int count(int x)
{
    int count = 0;
    while (x / 10 != 0)
    {
        x = x / 10;
        count++;
    }
    return count;
}

int main() 
{
    double x1 = 3.1415926;
    double x2 = 12345678.123456789;

    double x3 = x2;
    while ((int)x3 != 1)
    {
        x3 = x3 / 10;
    }
    
    printf("%lf %.6lfe+%0*d\n", x1, x1, 3, count(x1));
    printf("%lf %.6lfe+%0*d\n", x2, x3, 3, count(x2));
    return 0; 
}

    int N;
    scanf("%d", &N);

}
